st: What do you do when your head (and your pumpkin) explodes, every single day?

sec.p: I haven't written, haven't pressed a keyboard, in far too long. I missed it. Typing feels more and more like a new endurance sport: a physiological response to texts generated with a click, which are never, though, exactly what you had in mind. Thoughts are now like steps: to…

sec.t: ff.156.2 The Genie out of the lamp
sec.p: It isn't easy to understand who you want to be, to hold on to values and long-term projects, when every day the world seems different from yesterday's. Ever more simulated, perhaps, by Genie. We're all going through it. As Nathaniel Drew says in his latest video: Over the last…

Anyway, between Claude 5.5 and GPT Sol-Astra-Terra 6.1, between yet another marathon and the next, between yet another app and the next, I received a message. And I understood that perhaps what I've done over the last two years, the last five years, makes sense. And that it…
